name: Jim Corbett
tagline: Wilderness strategy conclaves & executive leadership drills
intro: Immersive forest luxury resorts along the Kosi River ideal for focused C-suite planning sessions, team survival challenges, and safaris.
access: Roughly six hours by road from Delhi.
highlights: Closest true wilderness retreat to Delhi NCR — a two-night offsite needs no flights at all.
Resorts here are built for groups: conference halls, bonfire lawns and activity areas on one campus.
Low cost per delegate relative to anywhere comparable, which makes it a repeatable annual format.
planning_note: Safari permits are capped and released on a schedule, so a safari for the whole group must be booked well before the stay. The park core closes during the monsoon.
